create_token_block_dataset: create a TokenBlockDataset to break a token dataset into fixed-size blocks for sequence modeling
build_slice_indices: build slice indices using _build_slice_indices to map blocks to underlying dataset token ranges
get_item_with_targets: get a data item with source, target, and past_target tensors using the __getitem__ method
review_break_modes: review the TokenBlockDataset class and its none, complete, complete_doc, and eos break modes
prefetch_dataset_blocks: prefetch specific block indices into memory using the prefetch method for faster data loading
